note: origin=captured files are real output of the CLIs named, scrubbed (no identity, no path, no secret) and, for claude init events, trimmed to the keys a connector reads. origin=derived files are captured streams with the listed fields edited; their wording is only as verified as wording_source says. origin=handwritten files are written by hand from the CLIs' documented or observed formats; nothing in them was captured, and their wording is only as verified as wording_source says. recorded_after names the fixture whose session this one continues: its counters (Claude total_cost_usd and modelUsage, Codex turn.completed.usage) are cumulative for the session, and the fake CLIs subtract that fixture to get the per-turn amounts (a derived file inherits it from its base).
